src/benchmark.c

The benchmark measures two paths on the same probes: complete resolution from raw text and candidate scoring from prepared text. Printing and report generation occur elsewhere.

Read the timer and summarize sorted samples

Section titled “Read the timer and summarize sorted samples”

POSIX builds use elapsed monotonic time. The isolated C99 fallback uses CPU time from clock. Standard qsort orders samples and trial means. P95 uses the nearest-rank index ceil(0.95*N)-1. Samples describe individual query latency; trial means describe variation across repetitions.

Download complete source
1/** @file2 * [PM-Be8tR5] Time matching, not printing or file work.3 * Prepare registry -> warm both paths -> time repeated queries -> sort samples.4 * A volatile checksum consumes results so GCC cannot discard the work.5 */6#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L7#include <stdlib.h>8#include <string.h>9#include <time.h>10#include "pm.h"11/* Written inside measured calls; never optimized away as an unused result. */12static volatile double sink;13/** Prefer elapsed monotonic time; portable C99 fallback measures CPU time. */14double now_ns(void) {15#if defined(_POSIX_TIMERS) || defined(CLOCK_MONOTONIC)16    struct timespec timing;17    if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &timing) == 0) return (double) timing.tv_sec * 1e9 + (double) timing.tv_nsec;18#endif19    return (double) clock() * 1e9 / (double) CLOCKS_PER_SEC;20}2122static int cmp_double(const void *a, const void *b) {23    double x = *(const double *) a, y = *(const double *) b;24    return (x > y) - (x < y);25}26/** [PM-Ti6mC4] Timing samples and trial means answer different questions.27 * Samples give latency percentiles. Trial means show variation across passes.28 * P95 uses ceil(.95*N)-1 in the sorted array; units remain nanoseconds here.29 */30static void summarize(Timing *timing, double *samples, size_t sample_count, double *trials, size_t repetitions) {31    size_t index;32    double total = 0;33    for (index = 0; index < sample_count; ++index) total += samples[index];34    qsort(samples, sample_count, sizeof *samples, cmp_double);35    qsort(trials, repetitions, sizeof *trials, cmp_double);36    timing->queries = sample_count;37    timing->total_ns = total;38    timing->mean_ns = total / (double) sample_count;39    timing->median_ns = sample_count % 2 ? samples[sample_count / 2] : (samples[sample_count / 2 - 1] + samples[sample_count / 2]) / 2;40    /* Nearest-rank percentile: 84 samples -> ceil(.95*84)=80 -> C index 79.41     * +99 rounds the integer division upward; -1 converts rank to array index. */42    timing->p95_ns = samples[(95 * sample_count + 99) / 100 - 1];43    timing->p99_ns = samples[(99 * sample_count + 99) / 100 - 1];44    timing->trial_median_ns = repetitions % 2 ? trials[repetitions / 2] : (trials[repetitions / 2 - 1] + trials[repetitions / 2]) / 2;45    timing->qps = 1e9 / timing->mean_ns;46    timing->trial_min_ns = trials[0];47    timing->trial_max_ns = trials[repetitions - 1];48}

Prepare, warm and consume every timed result

Section titled “Prepare, warm and consume every timed result”

Registry construction is measured separately. Twelve deterministic probes run at each of four registry sizes. Preparation is measured on its own and is also inside the end-to-end path. A warm-up exercises both paths before samples are recorded. The volatile checksum consumes results so the compiler cannot discard them. Heap allocations for timing arrays happen before the measured intervals and are freed afterward.

Reference for the contracts used in this file

Section titled “Reference for the contracts used in this file”

The POSIX reference defines the monotonic clock. This host measures elapsed time; the isolated C99 fallback instead uses CPU time. Open reference.

49/** The two paths use the same probes:50 * mode 0: raw text -> prepare -> exact/fuzzy -> decision.51 * mode 1: prepared text -> every candidate score; no ranking or decision.52 */53void benchmark_algorithm(size_t algorithm, Policy policy, const Options *options, Performance *performance) {54    const size_t sizes[] = {10, 50, 100, 1000};55    static Property properties[MAX_PROPERTIES];56    static Prepared queries[12];57    char inputs[12][KEY_MAX + 1];58    size_t size_index, query_index, repetition, mode;59    double scores[MAX_PROPERTIES];60    double *samples = malloc((size_t) options->repetitions * 12 * sizeof *samples), *trials = malloc((size_t) options->repetitions * sizeof *trials);61    if (!samples || !trials) {62        fprintf(stderr, "benchmark allocation failed\n");63        free(samples);64        free(trials);65        exit(1);66    }67    for (size_index = 0; size_index < 4; ++size_index) {68        Registry registry;69        double start = now_ns();70        if (!registry_scale(&registry, properties, sizes[size_index])) exit(1);71        performance[size_index].preprocessing_ns = now_ns() - start;72        performance[size_index].registry_size = sizes[size_index];73        for (query_index = 0; query_index < 12; ++query_index) {74            size_t property_index = query_index < 10 ? query_index : sizes[size_index] - 1 - (query_index - 10);75            const char *normalized = properties[property_index].normalized;76            /* Both arrays have KEY_MAX+1 bytes; registry construction validated the source. */77            memcpy(inputs[query_index], normalized, strlen(normalized) + 1);78            if (strlen(inputs[query_index]) > 4) inputs[query_index][3] = 'x';79        }80        /* Measure preparation separately; it is also part of end-to-end timing. */81        start = now_ns();82        for (repetition = 0; repetition < 100; ++repetition) for (query_index = 0; query_index < 12; ++query_index) {83            (void) prepare(inputs[query_index], &queries[query_index]);84            sink += (double) queries[query_index].ntokens;85        }86        performance[size_index].normalization_ns = (now_ns() - start) / 1200;87        /* Warm both paths, including candidate preprocessing, before timing. */88        for (query_index = 0; query_index < 12; ++query_index) {89            Resolution result = resolve(&registry, inputs[query_index], algorithm, policy);90            sink += result.best;91            score_candidates(&registry, &queries[query_index], algorithm, scores);92            sink += scores[0];93        }94        for (mode = 0; mode < 2; ++mode) {95            size_t index = 0;96            for (repetition = 0; repetition < options->repetitions; ++repetition) {97                double total = 0;98                for (query_index = 0; query_index < 12; ++query_index) {99                    double elapsed;100                    /* Measured interval starts here; report work is outside this function. */101                    start = now_ns();102                    if (mode == 0) {103                        Resolution result = resolve(&registry, inputs[query_index], algorithm, policy);104                        sink += result.best + (double) result.status;105                    } else {106                        score_candidates(&registry, &queries[query_index], algorithm, scores);107                        sink += scores[query_index % sizes[size_index]];108                    }109                    elapsed = now_ns() - start;110                    samples[index++] = elapsed;111                    total += elapsed;112                }113                trials[repetition] = total / 12;114            }115            summarize(mode == 0 ? &performance[size_index].end : &performance[size_index].score, samples, index, trials, options->repetitions);116        }117    }118    free(samples);119    free(trials);120}
